provenance.authored_by: hand-transcribed from TI INA219 datasheet pin-description table by Nelson (class-1 authority per CLAUDE.md KB-authoring doctrine); NOT derived from the datasheets_parsed Haiku cache or any PDF read by CC
provenance.agreement_gate: SDA/SCL 3-way (landing #1, 2026-07-12): (a) human-verified datasheet pin table (authority), (b) datasheets_parsed/ina219aidcnr/auto/ina219aidcnr_pin_groups.json Haiku cache (cross-check), (c) jetson-agx-thor-baseboard dcdc.net KiCad symbol pin names (cross-check) — all three agreed pin 5=SCL, pin 6=SDA, no disagreement.
provenance.a0_a1_decision: A0/A1 (address-select pins, strapped directly onto GND/VS/SDA/SCL per TI's 16-address scheme) were investigated as a possible KB addition (agreement gate passed, enum literals verified) but INITIALLY REJECTED (STOP #2, 2026-07-12) after a bare-gpio-role attempt produced 4 false FAILs (2 PROTOCOL_MISMATCH + 2 CAPABILITY_MISMATCH/M14 'dead bus') on the real jetson-agx-thor-baseboard bus — check_i2c_peripheral Step 4 and the M14 voter layer both interpreted a KB'd non-I2C-role pin wired onto an I2C net as a genuine miswiring, correct for a stray MCU GPIO pin but wrong for a fixed-function part's intentional address strap. Todo 240 (2026-07-15) built the missing schema affordance: PinFunctionEntry.strap (StrapInfo, datasheet-cited), consumed at exactly two sites (step_08d Step 4, peripheral_consensus M14 incapable_candidate) to exempt a KB'd pin with zero relevant roles from condemnation without ever letting it CONFIRM bus identity. A0/A1 below are now KB'd as strap-marked (no possible_roles, strap.datasheet_ref cited) — Phase 2 landing, see landing_ina219/REPORT_AMENDMENT.md for the original false-FAIL evidence and investigation/experiments/strap_semantics_recon/PHASE2_PREDICTION.md for the corpus-wide projection this entry was measured against.

i2c_note: INA219 is a fixed-function I2C sensor (current/power monitor), not an MCU alt-fn mux. SDA/SCL are single-purpose silicon pins — no possible_roles menu, function_class=fixed applies to them specifically. A0/A1 are address-select strap pins (Todo 240): zero possible_roles (they carry no I2C signal), marked via the `strap` field so the capability gates exempt rather than condemn them when strapped onto a bus line. Remaining non-I2C pins (IN+, IN-, GND, VS) are deliberately omitted — no bus-adjacent role, no condemnation risk to exempt.
